sources.title: Centennial Jing-Zhang AI Innovation Belt repository site package
sources.usage: Project brief, enums, standards, allowed design space, ranges, schemas, and provisional intake geometry.
sources.limitations: Each nested source retains its own authority and usability status; the package as a whole is not an official precise boundary.

sources.title: Repository public source registry
sources.usage: Distinguishes formal-ready, background-only, provisional-only, and needs-review materials.
sources.limitations: Unlisted participant sources are not centrally approved merely because they are cited here.

sources.title: Agent-readable processed fact pack
sources.usage: Navigation for scopes, tasks, source-use boundaries, and missing-data checklist.
sources.limitations: Processed navigation only; not a new authority source.

sources.title: Provisional Jing-Zhang AI Belt boundaries
sources.usage: Generation, visualisation, topology checks, and provisional spatial discussion.
sources.limitations: Not an official redline, approval basis, precise-area source, or statutory control.

sources.title: Provisional polygons for the three key areas
sources.usage: Provisional key-area differentiation and package intake checks.
sources.limitations: The rectangles are not parcels, road redlines, or official detailed-design boundaries.

sources.title: 百年京张AI创新带城市设计国际方案征集资格预审公告
sources.publisher: 北京市规划和自然资源委员会海淀分局
sources.usage: Official project purpose, scope levels, key-area names and announced areas, and design tasks.
sources.limitations: Does not supply precise public polygons or approved site controls.

sources.title: 面向全球智能体开展百年京张AI创新带城市设计开源征集任务书摘录
sources.usage: Agent principles, three positions, five functions, Three Zones and Two Wings, six tasks, scenarios, brand, and long-term operations.
sources.limitations: Repository taskbook excerpt; it does not establish statutory approval or a government implementation commitment.

sources.title: 中华人民共和国无障碍环境建设法
sources.publisher: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会
sources.usage: Accessibility design and expressly scoped human-service requirements.
sources.limitations: Not a site compliance finding; Article 39 is not generalised beyond its stated public-service contexts.

sources.title: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法
sources.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室等七部门
sources.usage: Applicable public generative-AI service handling, complaint channel, and provider-responsibility context.
sources.limitations: Not a legal opinion, universal opt-out rule, filing evidence, or approval.

sources.title: 关于切实解决老年人运用智能技术困难实施方案
sources.usage: Background for retaining traditional service channels alongside smart services.
sources.limitations: Background only; its phased goals ended by 2022 and it proves no current Haidian implementation.

sources.title: Directive (EU) 2024/1799 on common rules promoting the repair of goods
sources.usage: Mechanism reference for repair information, service access, and product-life extension.
sources.limitations: EU consumer-goods law; not Chinese law, urban-AI regulation, or a Beijing planning standard.

sources.title: Indice de réparabilité
sources.usage: Mechanism reference for making documentation, disassembly, and spare-part conditions legible.
sources.limitations: Product-specific French framework; no score or threshold is transferred to this proposal.

sources.title: Repair Café Foundation
sources.usage: Community skill-sharing and visible repair as an operating mechanism.
sources.limitations: No claim that its volunteer model, counts, or results transfer directly to Haidian.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.usage: Voluntary Govern–Map–Measure–Manage lifecycle for scenario governance.
sources.limitations: Voluntary, non-sector-specific framework; not Chinese regulation or certification.

sources.title: Sectorial AI Testing and Experimentation Facilities
sources.usage: Physical and virtual real-world AI testing and validation mechanism.
sources.limitations: No imported certification, regulatory sandbox, funding, or authority.

sources.title: Punggol Digital District
sources.usage: Integrated industry, education, community, and open digital-platform mechanism.
sources.limitations: No transfer of Singapore scale, investment, technology stack, or governance authority.

sources.title: 京张基本功 / JINGZHANG BASICS：先把十件小事做可靠
sources.usage: Attributed peer mechanism for service continuity, staffed responsibility, and non-AI fallback; used to establish differentiation.
sources.limitations: Its text and design remain the peer author's work; this proposal does not copy its ten-service framework. The cache path is git-ignored and not part of this package.

sources.title: Jing-Zhang Repair Line conceptual cover
sources.usage: Conceptual cover and visual narrative only.
sources.limitations: Not a site photograph, official rendering, public-consultation record, spatial evidence, or approval evidence.

sources.title: Local deterministic submission toolchain
sources.publisher: OpenAI Codex and upstream open-source projects
sources.usage: Generates geometry metadata, metrics, bilingual figures, offline HTML, and PDFs from local evidence.
sources.limitations: Uses local Python, Pillow, Shapely, pyproj, ReportLab, and system fonts; dependencies and font files are not redistributed.
